blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alex Eala was not penalized by the WTA for skipping a mandatory tournament to represent the Philippines in the Asian Games 2026, according to Philippine Tennis Association executive director Tonette Mendoza. In a Senate hearing conducted by the Committee on Sports on Thursday in the aftermath of the Asian Games, Mendoza said Eala was not sanctioned for missing the WTA 1000 China Open, which was held at the same time as the continental meet in Aichi-Nagoya.
